info.title: CMA CGM API SpotOn

changes: VAS “Lock My Price” is offered for Seareward grades Master and Admiral
In POST offers/{offerId}/quotations response - New 'potentialFees' details on fees potentially applicable in case of booking amendment or cancellation
new field offerType to identify if offer is on exact routing or alternate routing
In POST offers/{offerId}/quotations - New attributes ‘vasCode’ and ‘subscription’ flag to create a SpotOn quotation including value-added services from our CMA CGM+ catalog.
Possible to request on hazardous cargo and Shipper owned container
Payment method "As per freight" instead of "Known at booking stage"
It is possible to request a specific commodity HS Code, as most offers on reefers are for specific commodities.
A new parameter, spotDDSMConditionsOnly, has been introduced to limit DDSM details to specific conditions, resulting in better response times.
Request offer for non operating reefer (NOR)
Visibility on SpotOn offers on FMC scope
Eligibility of FAK depends on trades
Integration with AQUA Spot Pricing tool
NEW end-point regarding convertion of offer to SpotOn contract

info.description:
CMA CGM Business service - methods related to spotOn pricing offers  

This API offers the ability to consult spot offers and to request the conversion of the offer in a quotation

tags.name: SpotOn offer
tags.description: List of spotOn offers with surcharge details, DDSM conditions and related routing

post.description:
Search spot rate for Standard and Reefer (operating or not) equipment. You can launch a spot request for all carriers of the CMA CGM Group. This API will deliver an offer applicable for one carrier only.

Multiple equipment sizes within the same category can be requested simultaneously.

Requests for Hazardous commodity and Shipper Owned Container are supported: Specific conditions are applicable and are detailed on the B2B contract signed with CMA CGM Group.


Offer includes ocean freight, applicable surcharges.


If specific DDSM conditions are applicable for SpotOn, they will be detailed in the offer. Standard DDSM conditions are also provided by default but you can avoid that to have better response time.

BTW General DDSM conditions can be consulted using our DDSM API.

In case of limited spotOn allocation available, a spotOn with partial offer is provided.


Some schedules could be pushed in the result without offer because one of following reason:  
  * spot rate is not available
  * Allocation is sold out
  * Quantities must be reviewed

**SpotOn Inland:**  
  * Request with inland receipt and/or delivery city are accepted.
  * Providing ports is not mandatory and the process will automatically found applicable route.
  * Offer can be automatically adapted depending on available haulage (carrier or merchant) 

**Restrictions**:
  * Special equipments are excluded.
  * Requests on FMC perimeter (US) are possible for rate consulting only (cannot be converted in QSPOT quotation for the moment).
  * Local surcharges are not provided.

**Usage:**
  * At export : 'placeOfOrigin' _OR_ 'portOfLoading' is **mandatory**.
  * At import : 'portOfDischarge' _OR_ 'placeOfDelivery' is **mandatory**.
  * Equipment group Iso code, number of containers and weight parameters are **mandatory**.
  * Pagination is managed on list of results (schedules with offer). Next results are retrieved by changing the Range value.
  * Offers are provided for next schedules (when available).

cma-func-explain.description:
Code - INQ_OK - Description - OK  
Code - INQ_WAD - Description - Weight has been adjusted on some equipment types  
Code - INQ_PART1 - Partial offer on quantity or equipment type. Offer is auto adjusted  
Code - INQ_PART2 - Offer not provided on some equipment types because of too important quantities: Please adjust your request based on available TEUs  
Code - INL_EXP1 - Export haulage DOOR instead of RAMP  
Code - INL_EXP2 - Export haulage RAMP instead of DOOR  
Code - INL_IMP1 - Import haulage DOOR instead of RAMP  
Code - INL_IMP2 - Import haulage RAMP instead of DOOR  
Code - INL_EXPN - No inland connexion available at export   
Code - INL_IMPN - No inland connexion available at import  
Code - INQ_RLT - SpotOn offer not available, reason provided in Message

Message.description:
Displaying reason why offer couldn't be provided
* Code - INQ_BLK - [Reason of blocking offer]
* Code - INQ_TRN - Description - SpotOn not deployed yet on this trade
* Code - INQ_SPN - Description - SpotOn offer not available for your search criteria  
* Code - INQ_USC - Description - At least 1 customer code is not eligible to offer on US scope  
* Code - INQ_FAK - Description - SpotOn offer not available for FAK on this route and equipment type  
* Code - VAS_UNS - VAS included in freight can't be unsubscribed

departureDate.description: Expected vessel departure date. When not set, default value is today.

locationCodificationType.description:
Defines which referential is used for ports and inland places for spot rates search. 
Possible values are: 'CMACGM' (internal CMA CGM codification) or 'UNLOCODE' (UN/LOCODE codification)

portOfLoading.description:
Port of loading (code).  
  Use the CMA CGM API referential.location to select the relevant point code.  
  Port is not mandatory if you have indicated a place of origin.

portOfDischarge.description:
Port of discharge (code).  
  Use the CMA CGM API referential.location to select the relevant point code.  
  Port is not mandatory if you have indicated a place of delivery.

commodityCode.description:
The commodity code can be either:  
  - 'FAK' group of commodities
  - A commodity HS code which can be selected thanks to the CMA CGM API referential.goodscodification. 
  
  For specififc commodity, we advise to use a HS Code between 4 and 6 digits.

spotDDSMConditionsOnly.description:
If set to 'true', only the conditions related to the proposed spot offer will be returned, else 'false' will also return the general conditions if no conditions are defined on the spot offer.

With 'true', response time will be better.

nonOperatingReefer.description: If the request concerns a reefer equipment (20RE or 40RH) with deactivated genset, then 'true', else 'false'

shipperOwnedContainer.description: If the request concerns equipments owned by the shipper, then 'true', else 'false'

hazardous.description: If the request concerns dangerous goods, then 'true', else 'false'

decidingParty.description:
Business deciding party code, the business owner of the quotation.
The partner on which a spot quote is requested.

placeOfOrigin.description:
Place of Origin (code).  
Use the CMA CGM API referential.location to select the relevant point code.

placeOfOriginType.description:
Place of Origin type.  
  Define if the inland point is a Ramp or a Door. Mandatory when placeOfOrigin is provided.

placeOfDelivery.description:
Place of Delivery (code).  
Use the CMA CGM API referential.location to select the relevant point code.

placeOfDeliveryType.description:
Place of Delivery type.  
  Define if the inland point is a Ramp or a Door. Mandatory when placeOfOrigin is provided.

shippingCompany.description:
The shipping company the rate is valid for.  
Use the CMA CGM API referential.shipping.company  to select the relevant shipping code.
  When none set, no restriction is applied: Offer is searched first on CMA CGM and on other carriers if not found.

vasCode.description: Code of the requested value added service

subscription.description: 'true' for the VAS to be subscribed, 'false' to unsubscribe to the VAS already included in quotation

RequestedEquipment.description: Different sizes can be requested but in same category dry or reefer.

equipmentGroupIsoCode.description:
Container Group ISO Code.  
  Use the CMA CGM API referential.packaging.v2 to list available ISO group codes

weightPerContainer.description: Estimated net weight per container (in KGM).

offerId.description:
Reference of the offer when existing. To be provided to convert offer in QSPOT quotation.  
Other possible values:
* 'no-offer' when no offer found for this schedule.
* 'Quantities cannot be confirmed' when remaining allocation is limited 
* 'Sold-out' when allocation is sold out
* 'Offer cannot be created under FMC scope' when rate is under FMC regulation

offerType.description:
Define if the provided offer's routing fully or partially matches the request  
* 'ExactRouting': When an offer fully matches the request  
* 'AlternateRouting': When an offer partially matches the request

solutionDescription.example: Service French Asia Line 3  /  Service Morocco Shuttle via TANGER MED, MA

totalCarbonFootprint.description: Total carbon footprint for the route.

ddsmConditions.description: Detention, demurrage, storage and monitoring conditions (Specific Spot or general, depending on the parameter spotDDSMConditionsOnly).

allocation.description: Define status of allocations for requested equipments

potentialFees.description: Fees potentially applicable in case of booking amendment or cancellation

shippingCompany.description: The shipping company the rate is valid for.

validityFrom.description: Validity From date of the quoteline

validityTo.description: Validity to date of the quoteline

commentToCustomer.example: Stop booking due to lack of service

feeder.description: True if the Vessel is a Feeder else false.

Allocation.description: Detailed allocation status per equipment size/type.

allocation.description: true if allocations are available (even partially). False if allocations are full.

partialAllocation.description: Indicates whether allocation is partial or not.

nbOfAvailableTeus.description: Number of available Teus, provided in case of partial allocation on several equipments.

port.description: true if the place is a port else false.

routinginformation.description: Specific comment concerning the routing the quoteline refers to.
routinginformation.example: via SGSIN - SB VOY (Subj. to space confirmation)

commodityGroup.description: true in case of group of commodities else false.

code.description: HS code of the commodity or FAK.

name.description: English description as per provider's referential (e.g. Marseille).

internalCode.description: Port code in CMA CGM referential (see CMA CGM Location API).

availableRate.description: true if a rate is possible for this equipment, else false

maxNetWeight.description: Max Net Weight per container (in TONS).

controlledAtmosphere.description: available for container with control atmosphere.

businessDecidingPartyCode.description: Internal ID of the business deciding party, the business owner of the quotation.

businessDecidingPartyName.description: Name of the business deciding party, the business owner of the quotation.

businessDecidingPartyCountry.description: Country code where the Business deciding party is located.

businessDecidingPartyCity.description: City name where the Business deciding party is located.

codificationType.description: type of codification such as UN/Locode, GLN, Coordinate.

codification.description: value related to the codification, if codification is UN/Locode, value will be location UN Locode value.

ModeOfTransport.description:
Transport modes involved :  
* Export between origin and port of loading if origin is a ramp or a door
* Import between port of discharge and destination if destination is a ramp or a door

code.description:
Transport mode code  
* 'RD' for Road,  
* 'RL' for Rail,  
* 'RR' for Rail/road,  
* 'BA' for Barge,  
* 'BR' for Barge/road.

HaulageMode.description: Haulage mode at Export and Import.

code.description: Haulage mode code such as 'P', 'R' or 'D'.

name.description: Haulage mode name such as 'Port', 'Ramp' or 'Door'.

reason.description:
HTTP error or Free text such as  Database Not Available , Invalid
Credential, Mandatory, Invalid Format,  Invalid Length,
ForbiddenValue, Invalid Data,...

code.description: Error Id,  Server Application error ID, Oracle error Id, ....

description.description: Human-readable error description including Data and Value

percentageRate.description: For charges defined in percentage of other charges.

pivotAmount.description: Calculated rate defined with basic freight currency in case the charge rate is calculated in other currency.

code.description:
Payment method code for the charge:  
* 'P'for Prepaid,  
* 'C'for Collect.
* 'BKG' for As per freight

simulationDate.description:
Date when surcharge has been calculated.  
Iso 8601 date format yyyy-mm-dd

matchingSurchargesPerEquipmentTypes.description: List of charges applicable for each requested cargo.

matchingBlSurcharges.description: List of charges applicable once for whole BL.

matchingSurchargesDefinedAsComments.description: List of charges comment. Can be applicable per cargo or per BL.

equipmentGroupIsoCode.description:
Container group code.  
Example '20GP' for general purpose.  
You can refer to the CMA CGM API referential.packaging.

allInRate.description: Basic ocean freight for one equipment + cargo surcharges.

basicOceanFreightRate.description: Basic ocean freight for one equipment.

matchingCargoSurcharges.description: List of charges for a given equipment size and type.

surcharge.description: true if it's a surcharge else false (freight).

fixedByPricer.description: true if this charge is fixed by the pricer else false.

includedInBasicFreight.description: true if this charge is included in Basic freight, else false.

chargeDefinedAsCommentTxt.description: Text on charge defined as comment.
chargeDefinedAsCommentTxt.example: Be advised that for any shipment of 20' equal or over 20 TONS, Container Gross Weight, an overweight surcharge will be applied.

remark.description: Remark about the free days and/or charges provided.
remark.example: NOT a VATOS special condition inconsistent with Merged General Tariff

feeType.description:
* Cancellation fees - Applies for all bookings cancelled between the 14th and 7th day before ETD.   
* No-Show fees - Applies for all bookings cancelled between the 6th day and the ETD or when containers eventually do not show up within the requested deadlines.   
* Amendment fees – Applies for Change of Vessel & Change of Destination (subject to specific conditions)

equipmentGroupIsoCode.description:
Container group code.  
Example '20GP' for general purpose.  
You can refer to the CMA CGM API referential.packaging.

code.description:
Tariff type code.
* 'DET' for Detention
* 'DEM' for Demurrage
* 'MER' for merged Detention and Demurrage
* 'STO' for Storage
* 'MON' for Monitoring

validityDateFrom.description: Validity date from which the DDSM tariff is applicable.

validityDateTo.description: Validity date to which the DDSM tariff is applicable.

code.description:
Tariff origin code.
* 'EXP' for Specific Spot
* 'GEN' for General conditions

name.description: Label of the tariff origin like 'DDSM Exceptions'

calculationType.description: Type of free days calculation like 'Calendar' or 'Working'

webBookingUrl.description: Pre filled url to book on the website with the Spot quotation created.
